major_cooldowns.name: Apotheosis
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Activate it after Halo is already out, with one Holy Word: Serenity charge banked for the cost discount, then spend every global on a Holy Word or on a heal that shortens one.

major_cooldowns.name: Halo
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it as raid damage begins so it keeps expanding and contracting through the damage window, and pair it with Apotheosis for the bonus healing both spells get from Archon.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Base spell id shared by name with several hero-talent variants (120644, 120692, 120696, 390964, 390971, 449840, 453094), none observed as a cast in the sampled parses; 120517 is the plain version the guide links inline.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Hymn
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it as your primary raid-damage cooldown; you can channel it through line of sight to hide from a mechanic, and it now grants you Guardian Spirit while channeling so ground effects will not kill you.

major_cooldowns.name: Holy Word: Serenity
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown for single-target healing, pooling a charge ahead of known incoming spike damage but never sitting on two stacks.

major_cooldowns.name: Holy Word: Sanctify
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown for area healing alongside Serenity; it is one of your two most powerful abilities, so never let it sit on two stacks.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not observed as a cast in the sampled parses (castable per its tooltip); the guide names it directly alongside Holy Word: Serenity as a core Holy Word.

major_cooldowns.name: Guardian Spirit
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Give it to a tank about to take lethal damage as a cheat death that restores them to 40 percent health, or self-cast it when no tank needs it since Priest has few other defensives.

rule.action: Send Halo first as raid damage starts, then activate Apotheosis while Halo is still out so both get the Archon bonus healing.

rule.description: Hold a Serenity charge for Apotheosis
rule.action: Do not dump your last Holy Word: Serenity charge right before Apotheosis; bank one so you get its cost discount and bonus healing.

rule.description: Surge of Light consumed on Prayer of Healing
rule.action: Spend the proc on Prayer of Healing before it expires; you can hold up to two stacks, so do not let one fall off unused.

rule.description: Do not overcap Prayer of Mending stacks
rule.action: Recast on an ally without stacks, or only refresh a stacked target if the leftover waste is small or the buff is about to expire.
